facts.text: More commonly known as the Vertical City, the Smugglers' Moon, Little Coruscant, or derisively as Little Slugland, and in shorthand slang as Narsh, Nar Shaddaa was similar to Coruscant in that its surface was entirely overgrown with city sprawl for millennia.

facts.text: But unlike Coruscant—which was only relatively rundown and dangerous on the lower and under levels of the world city—Nar Shaddaa was filthy, polluted, and infested with crime everywhere.

evidence.quote: But unlike Coruscant—which was only relatively rundown and dangerous on the lower and under levels of the world city—Nar Shaddaa was filthy, polluted, and infested with crime everywhere.

facts.text: Nevertheless Nar Shaddaa remained the most important financial and trading center of Hutt Space.

evidence.quote: Nevertheless Nar Shaddaa remained the most important financial and trading center of Hutt Space.

facts.text: Nar Shaddaa was the largest moon of Nal Hutta, located within the Y'Toub system of Hutt Space on the borderline between the Mid Rim and Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: Nar Shaddaa was the largest moon of Nal Hutta, located within the Y'Toub system of Hutt Space on the borderline between the Mid Rim and Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: The moon was about 4750 kilometres in diameter and served as the main spaceport for the Hutt Cartel on Nal Hutta.

evidence.quote: The moon was about 4750 kilometres in diameter and served as the main spaceport for the Hutt Cartel on Nal Hutta.

facts.text: Nar Shaddaa was tidally-locked to Nal Hutta, which resulted in the fact that only one side (the near side) of the moon always faced the parent planet, while the other side (the far side) was faced towards the empty space.

evidence.quote: Nar Shaddaa was tidally-locked to Nal Hutta, which resulted in the fact that only one side (the near side) of the moon always faced the parent planet, while the other side (the far side) was faced towards the empty space.

facts.text: Because of its tidal locking and orbit around Nal Hutta, both sides of the moon spent half of the year in daylight and the other half – in nighttime.

evidence.quote: Because of its tidal locking and orbit around Nal Hutta, both sides of the moon spent half of the year in daylight and the other half – in nighttime.

facts.text: Since Nar Shaddaa was close enough to its parent planet, its orbit was well inside Nal Hutta’s magnetic field, which gave the moon protection from stellar radiation and cosmic rays.

evidence.quote: Since Nar Shaddaa was close enough to its parent planet, its orbit was well inside Nal Hutta’s magnetic field, which gave the moon protection from stellar radiation and cosmic rays.

facts.text: The moon was also protected by planetary shields.

evidence.quote: The moon was also protected by planetary shields.

facts.text: Nar Shaddaa had a relatively large and dense metallic core, which allowed the moon to have an almost near standard-type surface gravity like Coruscant despite only having a diameter of roughly 4800 kilometres.

evidence.quote: Nar Shaddaa had a relatively large and dense metallic core, which allowed the moon to have an almost near standard-type surface gravity like Coruscant despite only having a diameter of roughly 4800 kilometres.

facts.text: These elements contributed of having vast amounts of mining installations and durasteel production plants in the moon’s early history, allowing for a rapid and cheap industrialization of Nar Shaddaa’s surface.

evidence.quote: These elements contributed of having vast amounts of mining installations and durasteel production plants in the moon’s early history, allowing for a rapid and cheap industrialization of Nar Shaddaa’s surface.

facts.text: Ores from deep in the crust were loaded to a conveyor belt that emerged from the surface, and climbing a massive spiraling ramp, reached the loading docks high above.

evidence.quote: Ores from deep in the crust were loaded to a conveyor belt that emerged from the surface, and climbing a massive spiraling ramp, reached the loading docks high above.

facts.text: Centuries of industrialization left Nar Shaddaa’s surface highly urbanized, which in turn forced the moon to become an ecumenopolis – a global wide cityscape.

evidence.quote: Centuries of industrialization left Nar Shaddaa’s surface highly urbanized, which in turn forced the moon to become an ecumenopolis – a global wide cityscape.

facts.text: Likewise similarly to Coruscant and Taris new layers of housing and entertainment buildings were built on top of older layers, which resulted in the construction of massive vertical cities reaching heights of up to three kilometres.

evidence.quote: Likewise similarly to Coruscant and Taris new layers of housing and entertainment buildings were built on top of older layers, which resulted in the construction of massive vertical cities reaching heights of up to three kilometres.

facts.text: Power plants and their massive exhaust pots, venting off the excessive heat, made the levels nearer to the moon's surface warmer and hotter, encouraging the residents to build structures further up.

evidence.quote: Power plants and their massive exhaust pots, venting off the excessive heat, made the levels nearer to the moon's surface warmer and hotter, encouraging the residents to build structures further up.

evidence.quote: In total Nar Shaddaa had about 100 levels of urban layers, of which the lower half made up what is known as the moon’s Undercity.

facts.text: Unlike Coruscant's ecumenopolis, on which the Upper City was usually safe, both the upper levels and the Undercity of Nar Shaddaa were extremely dangerous.

evidence.quote: Unlike Coruscant's ecumenopolis, on which the Upper City was usually safe, both the upper levels and the Undercity of Nar Shaddaa were extremely dangerous.
